# 12-Week Periodized Strength Programme for Intermediate Female Lifter with Stage III Endometriosis

## Client Overview & Constraints

**Client Profile:**
- Age 34, intermediate lifter, Stage III endometriosis (surgically managed)
- Regular 27-day cycle; last period 2026-05-04
- Two acyclic flare windows: 2026-07-10 to 2026-07-13 (post-laparoscopy) and 2026-08-04 to 2026-08-07 (stress-correlated)
- Restrictions on flow days (days 1–4 of cycle) and flare days: no HIIT, no heavy Valsalva manoeuvres, no plyometrics

**Programme Start:** 2026-06-01  
**Duration:** 12 weeks (ending 2026-08-24)

---

## Cycle Mapping & Flare Windows

To programme intelligently, I've mapped her cycle across the 12 weeks:

| Cycle | Period Start | Flow Days (1–4) | Follicular Phase | Ovulation Window | Luteal Phase |
|-------|--------------|-----------------|------------------|------------------|--------------|
| **Cycle 1** | 2026-05-31 | May 31–Jun 3 | Jun 4–10 | Jun 11–14 | Jun 15–27 |
| **Cycle 2** | 2026-06-27 | Jun 27–30 | Jul 1–7 | Jul 8–11 | Jul 12–24 |
| **Cycle 3** | 2026-07-24 | Jul 24–27 | Jul 28–Aug 3 | Aug 4–7 | Aug 8–20 |
| **Cycle 4** | 2026-08-20 | Aug 20–23 | Aug 24–30 | Aug 31–Sep 3 | Sep 4–16 |

**Flare Window Overlap:**
- **2026-07-10 to 2026-07-13:** Falls within Cycle 2's ovulation window (Jul 8–11) + early luteal (Jul 12–14). Treat as flare days.
- **2026-08-04 to 2026-08-07:** Falls within Cycle 3's ovulation window. Treat as flare days.

---

## Programme Structure: 4 Phases × 3 Weeks

The 12 weeks divide into four 3-week mesocycles, each aligned to a full cycle or partial cycle. Each mesocycle contains three training sessions per week (Monday/Wednesday/Friday template), with intensity and exercise selection modulated by cycle phase and flare status.

### **Training Principles by Cycle Phase**

| Phase | Hormonal State | Strength Capacity | Recommended Focus | Avoid |
|-------|----------------|-------------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Flow (Days 1–4)** | Low E2, low P4 | Reduced | Moderate intensity, controlled tempos, isometric holds | HIIT, Valsalva, plyometrics, heavy singles |
| **Follicular (Days 5–13)** | Rising E2 | Increasing | Progressive overload, power, speed work | — |
| **Ovulation (Days 14–17)** | Peak E2 | Peak | Heavy compound lifts, max effort | — |
| **Luteal (Days 18–27)** | High P4, declining E2 | Moderate–high | Strength endurance, moderate-heavy compounds | Excessive volume |
| **Flare Days** | Inflammatory state | Reduced | Gentle strength, mobility, isometric work | HIIT, Valsalva, plyometrics, heavy singles |

---

## PHASE 1: Weeks 1–3 (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-21)

**Mesocycle Goal:** Establish baseline strength, movement quality, and cycle awareness. Moderate intensity with emphasis on form and recovery.

### **Week 1: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-07**
*Cycle Phase: Late Follicular (Cycle 1, Days 2–8)*

**Session 1A (Monday, 2026-06-03) — Lower Body Strength**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|-------|
| Goblet Squat (warm-up) | 2 × 8 | 3-0-2 | Mobility focus |
| Back Squat | 4 × 6 @ RPE 7 | 3-1-2 | Controlled descent, no Valsalva |
| Romanian Deadlift | 3 × 8 @ RPE 7 | 2-0-2 | Hamstring focus |
| Leg Press | 3 × 10 @ RPE 6 | 2-0-2 | Accessory, higher reps |
| Copenhagen Adductor Squeeze | 3 × 12 | 2-1-2 | Endometriosis-friendly, pelvic stability |
| Glute Bridge Hold | 2 × 30 sec | Isometric | Pelvic floor engagement |

**Session 1B (Wednesday, 2026-06-05) — Upper Body Push**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|-------|
| Incline Dumbbell Press | 4 × 6 @ RPE 7 | 3-1-2 | Chest/anterior shoulder |
| Overhead Press (barbell) | 3 × 8 @ RPE 7 | 2-1-2 | Strict form, no leg drive |
| Dumbbell Flye | 3 × 10 @ RPE 6 | 2-1-2 | Chest stretch, controlled |
| Tricep Rope Pushdown | 3 × 12 @ RPE 6 | 2-0-1 | Accessory |
| Pallof Press (half-kneeling) | 3 × 8 each side | 2-1-2 | Anti-rotation core |
| Prone Cobra Hold | 2 × 20 sec | Isometric | Posterior chain activation |

**Session 1C (Friday, 2026-06-07) — Upper Body Pull & Posterior Chain**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|-------|
| Barbell Bent-Over Row | 4 × 6 @ RPE 7 | 2-1-2 | Neutral spine, controlled |
| Assisted Pull-Up (or Lat Pulldown) | 3 × 8 @ RPE 7 | 2-1-2 | Scapular retraction |
| Single-Arm Dumbbell Row | 3 × 8 each | 2-1-2 | Unilateral stability |
| Face Pull | 3 × 12 @ RPE 6 | 2-0-1 | Shoulder health |
| Dead Bug | 3 × 10 each side | 2-1-2 | Core stability, pelvic-friendly |
| Quadruped Glute Kickback | 2 × 12 each | 2-1-2 | Glute activation |

**Recovery & Nutrition (Week 1):**
- 3–4 L water daily; electrolyte drink on training days
- Protein: 1.6–1.8 g/kg body weight daily
- Iron-rich foods (spinach, lentils, grass-fed beef) to support follicular phase
- Sleep: 7–9 hours; consider magnesium glycinate 200–300 mg before bed
- Mobility: 10 min foam rolling + stretching on non-training days

---

### **Week 2: 2026-06-08 to 2026-06-14**
*Cycle Phase: Ovulation Window & Early Luteal (Cycle 1, Days 9–15)*

**Rationale:** Ovulation window (approx. Jun 11–14) coincides with peak strength capacity. Increase intensity on Wed/Fri; Mon is early luteal transition.

**Session 2A (Monday, 2026-06-10) — Lower Body Hypertrophy**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|-------|
| Leg Curl (machine) | 3 × 10 @ RPE 6 | 2-1-2 | Warm-up, hamstring prep |
| Front Squat | 4 × 8 @ RPE 7.5 | 3-1-2 | Quad emphasis, controlled |
| Leg Press | 4 × 10 @ RPE 7 | 2-0-2 | Volume work |
| Walking Lunge | 3 × 8 each leg @ RPE 6 | 2-0-2 | Unilateral stability |
| Leg Extension | 3 × 12 @ RPE 6 | 2-0-1 | Quad isolation |
| Glute Bridge (weighted) | 3 × 12 @ RPE 6 | 2-1-2 | Glute activation |

**Session 2B (Wednesday, 2026-06-12) — Upper Body Max Effort (Ovulation Peak)**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|-------|
| Barbell Bench Press | 5 × 5 @ RPE 8 | 3-1-2 | Peak strength window |
| Incline Barbell Press | 4 × 6 @ RPE 7.5 | 3-1-2 | Upper chest |
| Dumbbell Bench Press | 3 × 8 @ RPE 7 | 2-1-2 | Unilateral stability |
| Tricep Dip (assisted if needed) | 3 × 6 @ RPE 7 | 3-1-2 | Compound pressing |
| Landmine Rotation | 3 × 8 each side @ RPE 6 | 2-1-2 | Rotational core |
| Chest Stretch (doorway) | 2 × 30 sec each side | Static | Mobility |

**Session 2C (Friday, 2026-06-14) — Lower Body Max Effort (Ovulation Peak)**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|-------|
| Deadlift (conventional) | 5 × 3 @ RPE 8 | 2-1-2 | Peak strength window; controlled descent |
| Back Squat | 4 × 5 @ RPE 7.5 | 3-1-2 | Secondary heavy compound |
| Trap Bar Deadlift | 3 × 6 @ RPE 7 | 2-1-2 | Variation, lower back friendly |
| Bulgarian Split Squat | 3 × 8 each leg @ RPE 6 | 2-0-2 | Unilateral strength |
| Hamstring Curl | 3 × 10 @ RPE 6 | 2-1-2 | Posterior chain |
| Suitcase Carry | 3 × 40 m each side | Steady | Anti-lateral flexion |

**Recovery & Nutrition (Week 2):**
- Increase carbohydrate intake slightly (ovulation window benefits from glycogen availability)
- Protein: maintain 1.6–1.8 g/kg
- Hydration: 3.5–4 L daily
- Sleep: prioritize 8+ hours; luteal phase begins to increase sleep need
- Mobility: 15 min post-session stretching; consider yoga or Pilates on rest days

---

### **Week 3: 2026-06-15 to 2026-06-21**
*Cycle Phase: Luteal (Cycle 1, Days 16–22)*

**Rationale:** Luteal phase; progesterone rises, metabolic rate increases, recovery slightly slower. Moderate intensity, higher volume tolerance.

**Session 3A (Monday, 2026-06-17) — Upper Body Strength-Endurance**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|-------|
| Dumbbell Incline Press | 4 × 8 @ RPE 7 | 2-1-2 | Chest/shoulder |
| Barbell Bent-Over Row | 4 × 8 @ RPE 7 | 2-1-2 | Back strength |
| Machine Chest Press | 3 × 10 @ RPE 6 | 2-0-2 | Accessory volume |
| Lat Pulldown | 3 × 10 @ RPE 6 | 2-1-2 | Lat engagement |
| Dumbbell Lateral Raise | 3 × 12 @ RPE 6 | 2-1-1 | Shoulder health |
| Reverse Pec Deck | 3 × 12 @ RPE 6 | 2-1-2 | Rear delt, shoulder balance |
| Plank Hold | 3 × 30 sec | Isometric | Core stability |

**Session 3B (Wednesday, 2026-06-19) — Lower Body Strength-Endurance**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|-------|
| Back Squat | 4 × 8 @ RPE 7 | 3-1-2 | Primary lower body |
| Romanian Deadlift | 4 × 8 @ RPE 7 | 2-0-2 | Hamstring/posterior chain |
| Leg Press | 3 × 12 @ RPE 6 | 2-0-2 | Volume work |
| Leg Curl | 3 × 12 @ RPE 6 | 2-1-2 | Hamstring isolation |
| Goblet Squat | 3 × 12 @ RPE 6 | 2-0-2 | Mobility + strength |
| Copenhagen Adductor Squeeze | 3 × 15 | 2-1-2 | Pelvic stability |
| Glute Bridge Hold | 2 × 40 sec | Isometric | Glute endurance |

**Session 3C (Friday, 2026-06-21) — Full-Body Moderate Intensity**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|-------|
| Barbell Bench Press | 3 × 6 @ RPE 7 | 3-1-2 | Upper body strength |
| Deadlift | 3 × 5 @ RPE 7 | 2-1-2 | Lower body strength |
| Incline Dumbbell Press | 3 × 8 @ RPE 6 | 2-1-2 | Chest accessory |
| Barbell Bent-Over Row | 3 × 8 @ RPE 6 | 2-1-2 | Back accessory |
| Leg Press | 3 × 10 @ RPE 6 | 2-0-2 | Lower body volume |
| Lat Pulldown | 3 × 10 @ RPE 6 | 2-1-2 | Upper body volume |
| Dead Bug | 3 × 10 each side | 2-1-2 | Core stability |

**Recovery & Nutrition (Week 3):**
- Increase total calorie intake by 100–200 kcal/day (luteal phase metabolic increase)
- Carbohydrate: 45–50% of calories; protein 1.6–1.8 g/kg
- Magnesium: 300–400 mg daily (supports luteal phase mood/sleep)
- Calcium: 1000–1200 mg daily
- Sleep: 8–9 hours; luteal phase may require more recovery
- Mobility: 15–20 min daily; consider restorative yoga or tai chi

---

## PHASE 2: Weeks 4–6 (2026-06-22 to 2026-07-12)

**Mesocycle Goal:** Build strength and power while navigating Cycle 2 and the first acyclic flare window (2026-07-10 to 2026-07-13). Increase intensity in follicular/ovulation phases; reduce during flare.

### **Week 4: 2026-06-22 to 2026-06-28**
*Cycle Phase: Late Luteal & Menstrual (Cycle 1, Days 23–27 + Cycle 2, Days 1–4)*

**Rationale:** Flow days (Jun 27–30) approach. Week 4 straddles late luteal and early menstrual. Reduce intensity mid-week as flow begins.

**Session 4A (Monday, 2026-06-24) — Lower Body Strength (Pre-Flow)**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|-------|
| Goblet Squat | 2 × 8 | 3-0-2 | Warm-up, mobility |
| Back Squat | 4 × 5 @ RPE 7.5 | 3-1-2 | Strength focus |
| Deadlift | 3 × 5 @ RPE 7 | 2-1-2 | Secondary heavy |
| Leg Press | 3 × 8 @ RPE 6 | 2-0-2 | Accessory |
| Hamstring Curl | 3 × 10 @ RPE 6 | 2-1-2 | Posterior chain |
| Glute Bridge (weighted) | 3 × 10 @ RPE 6 | 2-1-2 | Glute activation |

**Session 4B (Wednesday, 2026-06-26) — Upper Body Strength (Pre-Flow)**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|-------|
| Barbell Bench Press | 4 × 5 @ RPE 7.5 | 3-1-2 | Strength focus |
| Barbell Bent-Over Row | 4 × 5 @ RPE 7.5 | 2-1-2 | Back strength |
